description: Source file implementing SPDY/HTTP2 metadata frame handling, including sequence generation, frame parsing, and HPACK decoding.

classes.name: MetadataFrameSequence
classes.description: Handles creation of metadata frames, encoding payloads into SPDY frames.

classes.name: MetadataVisitor
classes.description: Parses and processes incoming metadata frames, manages HPACK decoding, and supports metadata support detection.

classes.name: MetadataVisitor::MetadataPayloadState
classes.description: Tracks the state of a metadata payload being received.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::MetadataFrameSequence
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a metadata frame sequence with a stream ID and payload.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::HasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more frames to generate.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::Next
methods.description: Generates the next SPDY frame IR for the metadata payload.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnSetting
methods.description: Handles SPDY/HTTP2 settings, particularly for metadata support extension.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Processes the header of a metadata frame, initializing state.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFramePayload
methods.description: Processes payload data of a metadata frame, performs HPACK decoding when complete.
